# CV Architect

> AI-powered resume builder that helps job seekers create ATS-optimized resumes, generate tailored cover letters, and land interviews faster.

CV Architect (https://cvarchitect.app) is a web application that uses artificial intelligence to help professionals and students build job-winning resumes. It rewrites existing resumes to beat Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), scores resumes against job descriptions, generates personalised cover letters, and provides expert feedback — all in minutes.

## Key Features

- **AI Resume Rewriter**: Paste a job description and CV Architect rewrites your resume to match the role's keywords and requirements automatically.
- **ATS Score Checker**: Analyses your resume against a job posting and gives a compatibility score (0–100) with specific improvement suggestions.
- **Cover Letter Generator**: Generates a personalised, professional cover letter tailored to any job description in seconds.
- **Resume Builder & Editor**: Full drag-and-drop resume editor with 10+ professional templates (Harvard, Executive, Modern, Minimalist, Creative, etc.).
- **PDF Export**: Export your polished resume as a pixel-perfect PDF.
- **Resume Upload & Parsing**: Upload an existing PDF or DOCX resume and CV Architect parses and imports it automatically.
- **Interview Question Generator**: Generates likely interview questions based on the job description and your resume.
- **Job Match Analysis**: Side-by-side breakdown of how your experience matches each requirement in a job posting.

## Pricing

- **Free Tier**: 3 AI credits included on sign-up. No credit card required.
- **Career Sprint**: $9 one-time payment — 7 days of unlimited access. No auto-renew.
- **Career Marathon**: $19/month — full access, cancel anytime.

## Who It's For

Students, recent graduates, professionals changing careers, anyone applying to jobs who wants to maximise their chances of passing ATS filters and getting to the interview stage.

## Differentiators vs Competitors

Unlike Resume.io, Zety, or Kickresume, CV Architect:
- Performs real-time AI rewriting against specific job descriptions (not just templates)
- Provides an ATS compatibility score with actionable feedback
- Generates cover letters personalised to both the role AND the user's background
- Offers a 7-day one-time access plan (no subscription trap)
- Is built for speed — most users complete a full resume rewrite in under 10 minutes
